THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Viral Watermelon Ice Cream, Proteinized

Viral Recipes Proteinized Ep. 3 — 1/2 cup Nurri Whole + 1 tsp honey scraped inside a frozen mini-watermelon shell. Shared bowl: 105 cal / 10g protein. Fun once with kids, not a Creami replacement.

YIELD2 servings
TOTAL TIME3 min + overnight freeze
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~53 cal | ~5g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 1/2 mini watermelon, center hollowed to a small well and frozen overnight cut-side up
  • 1/2 cup Nurri Whole Ultra-Filtered Protein Milk (85 cal / 10g protein — half the 1-cup 170/20 label)
  • 1 tsp honey (~21 cal — needed for sweetness)

Allergens: dairy.

You want to try the viral no-churn watermelon ice cream once with kids and want a proteinized honest take. This is a shared-bowl experiment, NOT a Ninja Creami replacement — the texture reads granita, not ice cream. Creator's verdict: fun once, not a repeat, but the scraping is a kid-magnet activity. Attribution: the trend was covered by ABC News and attributed to Alexa Santos (@alexawhatsfordinner).

Method

  1. 1.FREEZE THE WATERMELON. Halve a mini watermelon. Scoop out just enough of the center to make a small well (a shallow bowl, not a giant hollow — the well only needs to hold ~1/2 cup of liquid). Place the half cut-side up on a sheet pan and freeze overnight.
  2. 2.POUR THE PROTEIN MILK. Pull the frozen watermelon out of the freezer. Pour exactly 1/2 cup of Nurri Whole into the small frozen well. Don't assume every ready-to-drink protein shake will scrape the same way — Nurri Whole was chosen for its fat + protein blend.
  3. 3.SCRAPE UNTIL PINK + CREAMY. Use a spoon to scrape the frozen milk together with the small amount of frozen watermelon inside the well. Keep scraping until the mixture turns pink and granita-slushy — not ice-cream-smooth, more like snow-cone texture.
  4. 4.HONEY + SHARE IMMEDIATELY. Drizzle 1 tsp honey over the scraped dessert, scrape once more to marble it through, and serve straight from the watermelon shell with two spoons. Eat immediately — refreezing turns it icier and kills the trick.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid: Serve the kid portion as described above.

If something fails

Milk didn't freeze — sat as a puddle: Watermelon wasn't cold enough. It needs a real overnight freeze, not a 2-hour hurry. Check the flesh reads solid to a fork before pouring.

Scraped mixture is watery, not slushy: You used a lighter protein milk. Nurri WHOLE (fat + protein) freezes into a scrapable slush; low-fat protein shakes stay watery. Sub only with a similarly whole-milk-fat protein product.

Too sweet / too plain: Adjust the honey drizzle. 1 tsp is the tested dose; skip it if you want the fruit sweetness to carry, or push to 2 tsp for a sweeter kid version.

Kids fought over the shell: Two spoons, shared bowl. Or halve the watermelon into two smaller wells at the freeze step — kid-per-shell format works if the wells fit into 1/4 cup each.

Wanted actual ice cream: Use the Ninja Creami — this recipe is intentionally a scrape/granita experiment, not a churned ice cream. Try the Beach Bum Creami or Watermelon Nerds cookbook entries for a churned texture.

Storage and reheating

Store: Not a meal-prep dessert. Freeze the watermelon overnight (that's the only make-ahead component). Assemble the scrape at eat time. Refreezing the scraped mix makes it icier and worse.

Reheat: N/A — this is a frozen scrape dessert. Don't refreeze the finished mix.

Lasts: Frozen hollowed watermelon: 3-4 days in the freezer. Nurri Whole carton: per package date. Assembled scrape: eat immediately.

Estimated nutrition

~53 cal | ~5g protein.

Shared bowl (~105 cal / 10g protein) — 1/2 cup Nurri Whole (85 cal / 10g protein — half of the physical carton's 1-cup 170/20 label) + 1 tsp honey (~21 cal) + scraped watermelon (explicitly treated as negligible per creator instruction — a real serving of watermelon at ~30 cal per cup would push the total; verify if you scrape a heavier portion). Per shared half: ~53 cal / 5g protein. Retail formulas and labels drift; verify current Nurri Whole carton before publishing. Not a precision nutrition claim — the small scraped watermelon and any spill on the shell are excluded.

Brands I use

Nurri
Whole Ultra-Filtered Protein Milk (170 cal / 20g protein per 1-cup serving on the bought carton; recipe uses 1/2 cup = 85 cal / 10g protein)
The technique needs both fat and protein — whole ultra-filtered milk freezes into a scrapable slush inside the frozen watermelon well. Low-fat protein shakes stay watery. Product formulas shift; the physical carton in hand controls final nutritional data.
honey
1 tsp any real honey (~21 cal)
The sweetness anchor — the mix needs it. Skip the ultra-refined blends; local honey works fine at this dose.
